description: Bind the destination and explicit release_mode for this transfer before grasp generation. surface_setdown gently releases near a support; container_release releases above an open container rim only when task semantics permit dropping. Geometry and the operator setting determine height, never model coordinates. Rebinding invalidates old grasp/placement plans. Bind an observed support/container or an operator-configured work area for the current transfer. Preserve the original location requirement. A designated/set/configured area means the workbench setting and uses its exact XY; do not search for or visually invent a marker. A normal table/container permits region-based placement. Intermediate destinations need explicit semantic permission. This does not choose a collision-free XYZ or plan a path. Missing current destination identity returns unknown with observed_instance_missing_or_ambiguous. Author a bounded observation recovery when its prerequisites can be established. Retained valid collision layers can support an observation-map update before changing viewpoint. The recovery returns to destination binding and does not replay completed manipulation. When checking semantic permission for a reference outside the declared destinations, supply selected placement mode plus both task work-area/final-destination references, their configurations and current measurements. A different reference name alone does not prove a different physical location.
capability: Bind an observed support/container or an operator-configured work area for the current transfer
